View development documents.

Quick entry to macle open documents (minimum version macle 23.3.0)

To facilitate developers to quickly view open documents, Macle integrates development documents into the tool. Developers can quickly open development documents on the plug-in function page.

GUI

Modify the opening mode.

Currently, the following two modes are supported:

  • Open in VS Code: Open in the vscode editor (default)
  • Open in Chrome: Create a browser window and go to the open document page.

Developers can modify the document opening mode on the extended configuration page. For details, see Mini Program Configuration.
